# dbaas_catalog (Data Source)

Read the selected zone's engine, version, plan, topology, and recovery capabilities from the server.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `zone` (String) Exact configured DBaaS zone name or UUID. Use the computed UUID for subsequent operations.

### Read-Only

- `engines` (Attributes List) qualified database engines (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--engines))
- `plans` (Attributes List) released resource plans (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--plans))
- `zone_id` (String) CloudStack zone ID
- `zone_name` (String) Current CloudStack zone name
- `zones` (Attributes List) zones (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--zones))

<a id="nestedatt--engines"></a>
### Nested Schema for `engines`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) engine ID
- `name` (String) customer-visible engine name
- `versions` (Attributes List) qualified engine versions (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--engines--versions))

<a id="nestedatt--engines--versions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `engines.versions`

Read-Only:

- `backup_mode` (String) provider backup mode
- `cache_eviction_policy` (String) Provider-owned volatile key eviction policy
- `cache_memory_percent` (Number) Effective cache memory as a percentage of allocated offer memory, rounded down to bytes; remaining memory covers process/client overhead
- `create_allowed` (Boolean) Only the latest qualified installed version per generation is allowed for new instances. False retains existing-instance lifecycle and recovery only. Consumers must require true for creation.
- `disruptive_operations` (List of String) Operation kinds that interrupt service and empty the cache. Any process restart, replacement or failure may also lose every key.
- `generation` (String) Engine compatibility generation; assigned during release intake.
- `id` (String) engine version
- `plan_changes` (Attributes List) qualified directional plan changes (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--engines--versions--plan_changes))
- `plan_ids` (List of String) available plan IDs
- `recovery_retention_days` (Number) recovery retention after source deletion in days
- `restore_modes` (List of String) available restore modes
- `service_mode` (String) volatile_cache means reconstructible cache and best-effort notification triggers with external polling; no persistence, replicas, failover, backup or restore
- `storage` (Attributes) per-data-node storage bounds (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--engines--versions--storage))
- `topologies` (Attributes List) available topologies (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--engines--versions--topologies))
- `upgrade_from` (List of String) qualified source versions for in-place upgrade

<a id="nestedatt--engines--versions--plan_changes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `engines.versions.plan_changes`

Read-Only:

- `target` (String) target plan ID
- `update_from` (List of String) qualified source plan IDs


<a id="nestedatt--engines--versions--storage"></a>
### Nested Schema for `engines.versions.storage`

Read-Only:

- `maximum` (Number) maximum storage per data node in GiB
- `minimum` (Number) minimum storage per data node in GiB


<a id="nestedatt--engines--versions--topologies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `engines.versions.topologies`

Read-Only:

- `data_nodes` (Number) number of data-bearing nodes
- `id` (String) topology ID
- `name` (String) customer-visible topology name
- `update_from` (List of String) qualified source topologies for an in-place change




<a id="nestedatt--plans"></a>
### Nested Schema for `plans`

Read-Only:

- `cpu_limit_millicores` (Number) CPU limit in millicores
- `cpu_request_millicores` (Number) CPU request in millicores
- `id` (String) plan ID
- `memory_gib` (Number) memory per data node in GiB


<a id="nestedatt--zones"></a>
### Nested Schema for `zones`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) CloudStack zone UUID
- `name` (String) Current hosting cluster CloudStack zone name
